items.difficulty_reason: Two deep arguments in sequence: (i) reduction to $Y$ scheme via the groupoid chart $R = U \times_Y U$, where the functorial characterization forces $s^{-1}(V') = t^{-1}(V')$, descending the open to $Y$; (ii) the affine case by limit approximation: an inverse system of finite-presentation models over $\mathbf{Z}$ with affine transitions, descent of the invertible module, scheme-ness of the fibres after shrinking, ample spreading on the model (limits + Divisors lemmas), and the final pullback along the affine morphism $X \to Y \times_{Y_i} X_i$ (ingredients named by the author as hints).
